changes.now: Iron Man and the Hulk team up when the Abomination and MODOK unleash a creature of pure energy, Zzzax.
changes.proposed: Iron Man and the Hulk team up when the Abomination and two HYDRA scientists unleash a creature of pure energy, Zzzax.
changes.evidence: MODOK is not in Iron Man & Hulk: Heroes United. Two HYDRA scientists (Doctor Cruller and Doctor Fump) bring in the Abomination to capture the Hulk and drain his gamma energy into their own copy of Stark's arc reactor, and that creates Zzzax. The cast list is Iron Man, Hulk, Zzzax, Abomination, the two scientists, J.A.R.V.I.S. and Red Skull.

changes.now: Thanos steals the Avengers' quantum tunnel, and the team chases him through time to stop him from changing history.
changes.proposed: Thanos steals the Avengers' quantum tunnel and uses it to pull their old enemies out of the past, and the team has to track him down and stop him.
changes.evidence: The Avengers never travel through time in Time Twisted. The Chitauri steal Scott Lang's van with the Quantum Tunnel, and Thanos uses it to bring the Red Skull's past self, Iron Monger and Ultron into the present for an army. Ant-Man tracks the van to HYDRA's island base, the team fights them there in the present, and Scott shrinks the island into a bottle.
